import sys


def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    bal = {}
    for rec in s.split(','):
        rec = rec.strip()
        name = rec[:-2]
        num = int(rec[-1])
        if rec[-2] == '-':
            num = -num
        bal[name] = bal.get(name, 0) + num
    out = [f'{k} {v}' for k, v in bal.items()]
    print('\n'.join(out))


main()
